name: Victoria Peak
desc: The skyline you've screenshotted a hundred times, from above it. Tram up, jaw down.

name: Star Ferry
desc: Cross the harbour for pocket change — the cheapest million-dollar view on Earth.

name: Temple Street Night Market
desc: Neon signs, fortune tellers, clay-pot rice steam. Window shopping counts as a full evening plan here.

name: Tian Tan Big Buddha
desc: A 34-meter bronze Buddha sitting above the Lantau clouds. The 268 steps are free; so is the calm.

name: Dragon's Back Trail
desc: A ridge hike with beach-and-sea views the whole way. Costs nothing but one very sweaty T-shirt.

name: Avenue of Stars
desc: Kowloon waterfront facing the flashiest skyline alive. At 8pm the buildings literally perform a free light show.

name: M+ Museum
desc: Asia's giant visual-culture museum in a building that looks beamed in from the future. Someday-ticket energy.

name: Wong Tai Sin Temple
desc: Incense smoke, fortune sticks, and roof dragons. Ask for luck — it's the one thing here with no price tag.

name: Ding Ding Tram Ride
desc: Rattle across the island on a double-decker tram for cents. Front seat upstairs is broke-budget first class.

name: Ocean Park
desc: Roller coasters on a cliff over the South China Sea. The when-payday-finally-hits kind of day out.
